image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront named 'Boulangerie'. The facade features a large, curved glass display window filled with baked goods on shelves, illuminated by warm interior lighting. To the left is a glass door entrance with posted notices. Above the window is a white sign with stylized text and blue decorative panels. The building exterior appears to be stucco or painted concrete. There is visible graffiti on the upper wall sections adjacent to the shop signage.
